title: Lazar tells Lear 'John, it's real'
summary: Grant Cameron tells of Lazar tells Lear 'John, it's real', about December 1988 at Las Vegas, Nevada, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: think it's December the 6th. John Lair tells me a story. I'm sitting there. He says, "I'm writing checks." And uh Bob Lazar comes in. He says, "John, it's real."

plain: A UFO researcher named Grant Cameron says John Lear, a pilot and UFO enthusiast, told him a story from around 6 December 1988 in Las Vegas. According to Lear, Bob Lazar, a man who later said he worked on alien craft at a secret Nevada site, walked in and said, "John, it's real." If true, it marks the moment Lazar first claimed he had seen alien technology with his own eyes.
